title: Lake Tahoe Emerald Bay Airplane Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Flown by local, experienced mountain pilots. North Tahoe Aviation is owned & operated by a 20+ year local ski/mountain guide, bringing over a decade of mountain flying experience and local knowledge. 

Highlights: Emerald Bay and a full lap around Lake Tahoe. Including: Mt. Tallac, Fallen Leaf Lake, Cascade Lake, Desolation Wilderness, Heavenly Valley, The Godfather House, Thunderbird Lodge, Whale Beach, Sand Harbor & Incline Village.

Description: This flight is about 45 minutes long and can accommodate 1 - 3 passengers. You will fly to Emerald Bay while tracing the complete Lake Tahoe shoreline with beautiful panoramic mountain and lake views.

- 45-minute scenic flight over Lake Tahoe's highlights
- Explore Emerald Bay, Mt. Tallac, and Desolation Wilderness
- Ideal for 1-3 passengers with customizable flight paths
- Depart from Truckee Tahoe Airport with stunning aerial views
